## [0.6.0] - 2026-08-14

### Bug Fixes

- Bring the SIMD lexer under the crate-wide unsafe policy ([#676](https://github.com/fulcrumgenomics/fgumi/pull/676))

### Testing

- Compare long-record bytes, not just their length ([#693](https://github.com/fulcrumgenomics/fgumi/pull/693))

## [0.5.0] - 2026-07-28

### Bug Fixes

- Accept CRLF and unterminated final records (W9b: EXT3-06/07) ([#554](https://github.com/fulcrumgenomics/fgumi/pull/554))

### Features

- Validate record structure and surface errors instead of panicking ([#487](https://github.com/fulcrumgenomics/fgumi/pull/487))
- Accept uncompressed SAM and stdin anywhere BAM is accepted ([#644](https://github.com/fulcrumgenomics/fgumi/pull/644))

### Refactor

- Consolidate read-name suffix stripping and assert cross-parser parity ([#572](https://github.com/fulcrumgenomics/fgumi/pull/572))
